name: Metal nut visual defect detection
rationale: Catching bent, scratched, flipped or discoloured nuts at the press exit stops bad parts from reaching assembly.
framing: Binary detection: is the part in a top-camera image defective (any defect type) or good.
target_definition: 1 if the QC inspection found any defect on the imaged part, else 0
split_strategy: random 60/20/20, stratified by defect type (one image per physical part, so images are independent)
